equity_bridge.item: Investment securities at fair value (cross-shareholdings, bonds)
equity_bridge.note: 30 June 2026 balance sheet; dividend/interest on these is excluded from the flows (matching-asset rule). Down from JPY121,714m at March 2026 after sales in Q1.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue CAGR (FY2026-FY2036). Equity 5-yr CAGR 8.97% is the house primary, but FY2021-26 embeds ~3pp/yr of JPY depreciation (USD/JPY ~106 to ~151 average) and a cycle peak; 5% is the constant-currency trend plus a modest FX assumption, with a flat year inside the horizon.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3-yr CAGR +7.6% vs EPS 3-yr CAGR -8.5%: FY2023 was a cycle peak (EPS JPY3,445) and FY2026 EPS is 23% below it while book value kept compounding. Owner-FCF CAGRs are negative because capex rose from 5% to 18% of revenue over the window; they describe the capex supercycle, not earnings power.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less interest income; SBC nil), JPY m: FY2016 71,871; FY2017 90,777; FY2018 120,914; FY2019 35,007; FY2020 74,921; FY2021 84,217; FY2022 68,450; FY2023 15,518; FY2024 -24,562; FY2025 68,617; FY2026 14,069. Pre-2022 owner-FCF margin ran 13-20% of revenue on 4-5% capex; FY2024-26 is depressed by JPY105-154bn/yr of capacity capex and a JPY200bn inventory build.

scenario_narratives.base: SMC's axes are (1) the semiconductor/AI capex cycle, which drives its highest-margin clean-series and process-gas products and is the source of the Q1 FY2027 +35% quarter; (2) Greater China (36% of Q1 sales), where demand is broad-based across semis, FPD and batteries but local competitors are gaining; (3) USD/JPY, worth roughly 0.6-0.7pp of revenue growth per yen; and (4) the pay-off on the FY2022-26 capacity and inventory build, which took capex to 18% of revenue and inventory to 60%. Base: FY2027 lands on the unchanged JPY1,000bn guidance, the upcycle crests in FY2029, FY2030 is flat, mid-cycle EBITDA margin is 30-30.5% (below the 10-yr mean of 31.8%), capex normalises to 7.5% of revenue and owner-FCF margin matures at ~15%, in line with the pre-2022 record.
scenario_narratives.bull: The AI/advanced-packaging and China automation wave lasts through FY2029, SMC extends its ~26% global pneumatics share (double Festo's) with faster delivery off the new plants, and the yen stays weak. EBITDA margin returns to 33% as personnel and depreciation growth are absorbed by volume; no down year in the horizon.
scenario_narratives.bear: The June-2026 quarter was the top. Semicap orders pause from H2 FY2027, the yen strengthens, and Chinese localisation erodes share in the largest region. Revenue falls 13% peak-to-trough over FY2028-29, EBITDA margin troughs at 25% under the new depreciation load, and the market reverts to pricing SMC as a cyclical (15x cap, 2% terminal growth). Even here the JPY830bn of cash and securities is ~24% of the current market cap, which is why the bear value does not collapse.

valuation_philosophy.summary: SMC is valued as a mid-cycle cash compounder, not off the FY2026 trough FCF (JPY14bn owner FCF after a JPY154bn capex year) and not off the Q1 FY2027 peak run-rate. The component build lets capex glide from 18% to 7.5% of revenue while D&A rises to ~7%, so the mature owner-FCF margin (~15%) emerges by FY2030 rather than being assumed. Interest income is stripped and the JPY833bn of cash, deposits and securities is credited at face; SBC is genuinely zero so house and street coincide.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cycle timing: the model has FY2027 as an up-year and FY2030 flat; if the downturn comes in FY2028 instead, three years of FCF shift and the base case falls toward the bear.
Working capital: capture at -35% assumes inventory stays flat in yen through the upcycle; a return to the FY2023-24 pattern (inventory growing faster than sales) would absorb another JPY50-80bn/yr.
Capex normalisation: the glide from 18% to 7.5% is management's stated direction (FY2027 guide JPY100bn) but a further plant programme would push it out.
FX: USD/JPY of 155 is embedded in guidance; a move to 140 is a ~6% revenue and larger profit headwind, and most of the net cash is held offshore.
China share: 36% of revenue in a region where local pneumatics makers are improving; a structural share loss is not in the base case.
Terminal value is ~60% of EV; the 18x cap and 2.5% growth together drive ~JPY28k/share.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (Tokyo regular close); 52-week range 50,560-86,800.
data_sources.financials: 6273.T_Annual_FY2016-FY2026.txt (Reference Translation annual reports, 10-year summaries, consolidated statements), 6273.T_Quarterly_Q1-2026.txt (tanshin for the three months ended 30 June 2026 = Q1 FY2027: balance sheet, share counts, FY2027 forecast, capex/depreciation guidance, FX assumptions), core_metrics and kpis via make dcf-context.
data_sources.qualitative: Q1 FY2027 tanshin qualitative information (semiconductor-led recovery, China broad-based, Europe automotive stagnant); FY2026 annual report operating-results section. 6273.T_Analysis.json (2026-11-08) for competitive position, guidance history, risks and bull/bear points.

inputs.share_count_basis: 63,869,359 issued less 1,000,581 treasury (incl. 11,200 BBT shares) at 30 June 2026 = 62,868,778; Q1 FY2027 tanshin p.2. No dilutive securities (diluted EPS reported as nil). Held FLAT: SBC is zero so there is no grant dilution to charge; the JPY25-30bn/yr buyback (JPY30,018m FY2026) is funded from the net cash credited in the bridge and is treated as value-neutral. A JPY50bn authorisation runs to 24 March 2027 but only ~12% was executed by mid-2026; authorised is not spent, so buyback_cash is the FY2026 actual.
inputs.cash_note: Cash and deposits JPY711,089m + securities (short-term, mostly time deposits/bonds) JPY48,140m at 30 June 2026; short-term borrowings JPY5,000m, no long-term borrowings, no lease liabilities (J-GAAP). Cash and cash equivalents as defined by the company were JPY573,769m at 31 March 2026; the gap is time deposits > 3 months, counted here as liquid. Investment securities JPY78,977m (cross-shareholdings and bonds at fair value) are added separately in equity_bridge.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: OCF JPY188,917m less purchase of PP&E JPY152,701m and intangibles JPY1,684m, FY2026 (year ended 31 March 2026). The company's own 'free cash flow' (JPY81,405m) is OCF + total investing cash flow, which includes JPY42,249m of net time-deposit proceeds; not used.
inputs.sbc_source: No share-based payment line in the FY2016-FY2026 consolidated cash flow statements; the only equity-linked pay is the directors' Board Benefit Trust (JPY657m provision at 30 June 2026). SBC-zero market: house and street bases coincide.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2026 interest income JPY20,463m (FY2025 JPY20,237m; Q1 FY2027 JPY4,610m). Stripped from the flows because net cash is ~54x the owner-FCF base and is credited at face in the bridge. FX gains (JPY19,693m FY2026) and gains on sale of securities are below operating profit and are likewise excluded from the EBITDA build.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-06T06:30:00Z regular close, Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-built: 10y JGB ~1.8% + beta ~1.1 x JPY ERP ~5.5% = ~7.8-8.0% cost of equity; equity ratio 91%, borrowings JPY5bn, so WACC = cost of equity = 8.0%. Below the ~9% house reference for keiretsu suppliers because SMC is the global #1 in pneumatics (~26% share, roughly double #2 Festo), has no customer concentration and carries JPY750bn+ net cash. Same WACC in every scenario: cyclicality is charged in the flows, not the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: J-GAAP filer; operating leases are expensed in operating costs, so no lease adjustment and no lease liabilities in net debt. Non-current 'other' liabilities (JPY40,838m) are mainly deferred tax; not debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests JPY149m at 31 March 2026 (JPY25m FY2025) -- immaterial, ignored; flows are effectively 100% attributable.
inputs.working_capital_note: Capture -35% of the YoY revenue change: trade receivables ~30% of revenue, payables ~5%, inventories 60% of revenue (JPY506,698m at March 2026, up from ~40% pre-2022). Inventory is modelled as roughly flat in yen through the upcycle (the FY2024-25 stockpile unwinds into sales), so the capture is receivables-driven; if SMC rebuilds inventory at 60% of incremental revenue the capture would be nearer -85%, which is the main downside to year-1-3 FCF.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical'), 10-year explicit horizon FY2027-FY2036 because capex (17.8% of revenue in FY2026, 10% guided for FY2027) and D&A (5.3% rising to ~6.5-7%) are both mid-transition and the owner-FCF margin does not mature until ~FY2030. SMC is a cyclical global industrial: revenue fell 11% peak-to-trough FY2018-FY2020 and 6% FY2023-FY2024; EBITDA margin ranged 27.9% (FY2026) to 35.1% (FY2018), 10-year mean 31.8%. The base path uses a mid-cycle ~30% EBITDA margin and a flat year (FY2030) inside the horizon rather than a peak margin. Q1 FY2027 (+35.4% revenue, OP margin 27.3%) is treated as a genuine semicap/AI/China automation upturn off a trough comp with ~7-8pp FX help, not a run-rate: base FY2027 growth is 19%, in line with the unchanged JPY1,000bn guidance. Scenario axes cross-checked against 6273.T_Analysis.json (2026-11-08): its bull points (share leader, semicap inflection, net cash, automation secular layer, operating leverage) and bear points (single-category cyclical, Greater China concentration, yen, capex ahead of demand, tariffs/export controls) map onto the bull/bear driver paths above. Note FY2026 guidance was cut in Nov-2025 (sales 850->816bn, OP 215->183bn) and then beaten (842.5/190.6), which is why FY2027 guidance is read as conservative rather than taken at face. Price is the Friday 6 Nov Tokyo regular close.
inputs.sanity_fix_note: Sanity check passed on the first pass (2026-11-08): implied P/E 22.1x vs 10-yr ex-outlier mean 24.6x (range 18.7-34.6x), EV/EBITDA 12.9x vs 14.9x (10.3-21.3x), P/B 1.75x vs 2.46x. No fix applied; the build is mid-cycle by construction (30% EBITDA margin, capex glide 18%->7.5%, flat FY2030).

bear.narrative: Q1 FY2027 was the cycle peak: FY2027 lands at +12% (guidance missed on a yen back to ~140 and a semicap pause from H2), then a two-year downturn of -8%/-5% as in FY2019-20 and FY2024-25 combined, with Chinese localisation (Airtac and domestic valve makers) taking share and US tariffs/semiconductor export controls weighing on capex outside China, so the recovery is slower. Depreciation on the new plants lands on falling revenue and EBITDA margin troughs at 25% before settling at 27.5%. Terminal growth 2% and a 15x cap because the market treats it as a cyclical at the trough. 10-yr CAGR 1.6%.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 +19% = unchanged JPY1,000bn guidance (Q1 was 27% of it; SMC guides conservatively). FY2028 +8% as the semicap/AI cycle extends, FY2029 +3% as it crests, FY2030 flat (every SMC upcycle since 2010 has been followed by a flat-to-down year), then 4-5% recovery fading to 2.5% terminal. 10-yr CAGR 5.0% vs 5.9% nominal FY2016-26.
base.margin_rationale: FY2027 29.5% EBITDA (guide implies 28.1%, Q1 ran 32.2%); mid-cycle 30-30.5% vs 10-yr mean 31.8% and FY2026 27.9%. Personnel and depreciation growth cap the recovery below the FY2018/FY2023 peaks of 34-35%.
base.capex_rationale: FY2027 10% = JPY100bn guidance; glides to 7.5% as the Japan/Vietnam/China/India/Czech capacity programme completes. D&A rises to ~7% on the doubled asset base (FY2027 guide JPY62.3bn = 6.2%) then eases. Terminal capex 7.5% vs D&A 6.5%: ~1% of revenue net investment for 2.5% growth.
base.tax_rationale: 29% cash rate: FY2027 guidance implies ~28.5% effective (ordinary JPY239bn to NP JPY170bn); FY2022-26 cash taxes paid averaged ~28% of pre-tax profit; Japanese statutory ~30.6% diluted by China/Singapore/US mix.
base.terminal_rationale: Gordon at 8%/2.5% is 18.6x; capped at 18x FCF. SMC has traded 10-15x EV/EBITDA and 20-30x P/E through the cycle, so 18x mid-cycle owner FCF is not multiple expansion.

bull.narrative: FY2027 beats guidance at +25% (Q1 run-rate held), the AI/advanced-packaging capex wave runs two more years, China automation stays broad-based, no flat year until FY2030 and even that is +4%. Operating leverage on the new plants takes EBITDA margin back to 33%, close to the FY2018-23 peaks. 10-yr CAGR 7.3%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the 15/50/35 default to 25/50/25. Bear up to 25% because SMC's revenue has fallen after every upcycle in the past 15 years and Q1 FY2027's +35% on a trough comp is exactly where prior peaks sat; the semicap cycle can turn within two quarters. Bull down to 25% because it needs three independent things (sustained AI/semicap capex, broad China demand, a weak yen) and already-high Q1 margins to all hold. Net cash of ~24% of market cap and 91% equity ratio mean there is no solvency axis, so bear does not go higher.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
